synth.notes:
Player moves 3 over colours {1,4} within portal bounds; hitting tokens kicks them instead (push chain, 1 cell/tick over {1,4,15}, stops at walls/player/non-fitting socket interior).
Sprites: token e+5 centre; player e+0 centre plus 0 edge on any side touching a token.
Click on token: player takes its rect, old player left as an inert husk (centre 4) in the background.
HUD row 63: zeros from right = ceil(actions/2) since level start; parity kept via continuity (stateless fallback 15/29).
Unconfirmed: exact-fit socket entry, husk collision, empty-click HUD counting.
